rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The party organ reports that on the 22nd 公明党 held its ninth national convention and set out on its advance led by the re-elected 山口那津男代表 ('第9回全国大会を開き、再任された山口那津男代表を先頭に').
